Harkless''' (born February 3, 2000){{cite web|title=Elijah Harkless - College Stats|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/elijah-harkless-1.html|website=Sports-Reference.com|access-date=September 14, 2024}} is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Detroit Pistons]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA), on a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Motor City Cruise]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Cal State Northridge Matadors men's basketball|Cal State Northridge Matadors]], [[Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball|Oklahoma Sooners]] and [[UNLV Runnin' Rebels basketball|UNLV Runnin' Rebels]]. Harkless signed with the [[Ontario Clippers]] of the NBA G League after going undrafted in the [[2023 NBA draft]]. ==High school career== Harkless attended [[Etiwanda High School]] at [[Rancho Cucamonga, California]], leading his team to a 30–4 record and a third-place finish at the CIF Southern Section Open Division Tournament as a senior while averaging over 10 points and five assists. He was named to the All-Baseline First Team and to the Sun-Daily Bulletin All-Area Team.{{cite web|title=Elijah Harkless - MEN'S BASKETBALL|url=https://gomatadors.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/elijah-harkless/3899|website=GoMatadors.com|access-date=September 14, 2024}}{{cite web|title=Elijah Harkless - MEN'S BASKETBALL|url=https://soonersports.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/elijah-harkless/14871|website=SoonerSports.com|access-date=September 14, 2024}}{{cite web|title=EJ Harkless - MEN'S BASKETBALL|url=https://unlvrebels.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/ej-harkless/15148|website=UNLVRebels.com|access-date=September 14, 2024}} ==College career== Harkless initially attended [[Cal State Northridge Matadors men's basketball|Cal State Northridge]] (CSUN) where he played 51 games in two seasons while averaging 8.1 points, 4.5 rebounds, 2.6 assists and 1.4 steals in 23.6 minutes and in his sophomore year, he became the first CSUN player to record a [[triple-double]] and the first player since 2005 to get 54 steals in a single season.{{cite web|first=Brennan|last=Elliott|title=Clippers Guard, Harkless Signs for 2024 Season|url=https://www.therattlers.ca/harkless-2024|website=TheRattlers.ca|date=April 25, 2024|access-date=September 14, 2024}} As a junior, Harkless transferred to [[Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball|Oklahoma]], where he played 49 games over two seasons and averaged 9.1 points, 4.7 rebounds, two assists and 1.6 steals in 28.8 minutes. In his final season, Harkless transferred to [[UNLV Runnin' Rebels basketball|UNLV]], where he started in all 32 games and averaged a career-high 19.1 points, 5.1 rebounds, 3.4 assists and 1.6 steals in 30.9 minutes while leading his team in total points with 611, total rebounds with 163, total assists with 108, total minutes with 991 and total games. ==Professional career== ===Ontario Clippers (2023–2024)=== After going undrafted in the [[2023 NBA draft]], Harkless joined the [[Ontario Clippers]] on October 30, 2023.{{cite web |date=October 30, 2023 |title=Ontario Clippers Announce Training Camp Roster for 2023-24 NBA G League Season |url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/ontario-clippers-announce-training-camp-roster-for-2023-24-nba-g-league-season/n-6027173 |access-date=September 14, 2024 |website=OurSportsCentral.com}} He played 20 games and averaged 11.6 points, 3.9 rebounds, 3.2 assists and one steal in 22.6 minutes while shooting 47.5% from the field. ===Saskatchewan Rattlers (2024)=== On April 25, 2024, Harkless signed with the [[Saskatchewan Rattlers]] of the [[Canadian Elite Basketball League]] where he played 27 games and averaged 11.4 points, 3.7 rebounds, 2.9 assists and one steal in 20.7 minutes.{{cite web|first=Rory|last=Maher|title=Clippers Sign Elijah Harkless To Exhibit 10 Contract|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/09/clippers-to-sign-elijah-harkless-to-exhibit-10-contract.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=September 5, 2024|access-date=September 14, 2024}} On July 25, he was released by the Rattlers. ===San Diego Clippers (2024)=== After joining them for the [[2024 NBA Summer League]],{{cite web|title=2024 NBA2K25 Summer League Roster|url=https://www.nba.com/summer-league/2024/las-vegas/team/1610612746/clippers|website=NBA.com|access-date=September 14, 2024}} on September 4, 2024, Harkless signed with the [[Los Angeles Clippers]]. However, he was waived on September 26{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Two Jazz Signings Among NBA’s Latest Minor Moves|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/09/two-jazz-signings-among-nbas-latest-minor-moves.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=September 28, 2024|access-date=September 28, 2024}} and re-signed on October 9.{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Clippers Waive RayJ Dennis, Re-Sign Elijah Harkless|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/10/clippers-waive-rayj-dennis.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 9, 2024|access-date=October 9, 2024}} However, he was waived once again on October 19.{{cite web|first=Arthur|last=Hill|title=Clippers Waive Elijah Harkless, Alondes Williams, Braxton Key|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/10/clippers-waive-elijah-harkless-alondes-williams-braxton-key.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 19, 2024|access-date=October 21, 2024}} On October 28, he joined the [[San Diego Clippers (NBA G League)|San Diego Clippers]].{{cite web|title=SAN DIEGO CLIPPERS ANNOUNCE TRAINING CAMP ROSTER FOR 2024-25 NBA G LEAGUE SEASON|url=https://sandiego.gleague.nba.com/news/san-diego-clippers-announce-training-camp-roster-for-2024-25-nba-g-league-season|website=NBA.com|date=October 28, 2024|access-date=November 2, 2024}}
